profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at General Dynamics Information Technology
profile.summary:
I'm a software engineer with 16 years experience and a background in computational biology and physics. I am passionate about healthtech and open science.  I am curious about where both AI and quantum computing are headed.

I am always open to new opportunities so feel free to reach out.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Developing the NHLBI BioData Catalyst platform to help researchers discover, share, and analyze NHLBI data resources.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Architected and developed a system to monitor AWS infrastructure using AWS CloudWatch, AWS CloudTrail, and AWS Glue to ensure compliance with Federal Information Processing Standards (FIPS) 140 standards
- Implemented an ELT process to copy terabytes of medical image files from Google Cloud Storage to AWS S3 using AWS DataSync
- Developed the front end of the Imaging Data Commons web portal using the Django web framework and the JQuery, DataTables, Bootstrap, and D3 JavaScript libraries to allow users to search medical imaging data and view image metadata in tables and charts
- Developed portions of the backend of the Imaging Data Commons web portal in Python and SOLR to fetch image metadata
- Created a suite of web portal tests with Cypress
- Currently refactoring the front end of the ISB-CGC web portal to use Bootstrap v5 in place of v3
- Designed a process for ingesting free form clinical data from disparate sources into Google BigQuery
positions.insights: Skills: SQL · Google Cloud Platform (GCP) · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · JavaScript · Python (Programming Language) · Amazon Web Services (AWS)

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Refactored legacy code into a cloud compatible microservice architecture
- Developed and maintained automated tools using Java and Postgres to curate a continuous stream of ad service data
- Developed web services and applications in Java and JavasScript to allow clients to view data in tables and charts
- Trained random forest models using the scikit-learn python library to predict fill rates for ad campaigns
- Developed and implemented a business rules engine in Java and JavaScript for setting price floors for online ad sales auctions
- Maintained a Linux cluster of 12 servers responsible for ad management and delivery
- Configured and deployed AWS EC2 instances in production and test environments
positions.insights: Skills: SQL · Java · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · JavaScript · Project Management · Amazon Web Services (AWS)

positions.title: Research Associate
positions.description:
- Predicted new therapies for several viral diseases using computational biology and bioinformatics techniques
  - Designed a PostgreSQL database of drug compound, disease, and protein information for use in computational drug discovery
  - Designed a RESTful API in Python/SQLalchemy to support web services that reference the above database (http://cando.compbio.washington.edu/api/index.html)
  - Wrote and tested Perl code for structure based drug/protein and peptide/protein docking applications 
  - Wrote the front end of BINDNET (http://cando.compbio.washington.edu/servers/bindnet/), a web server that predicts protein/ligand interactions

company.name: Samudrala Computational Biology Group, University of Washington

positions.title: Project Manager
positions.description:
- Led a team of 4 people in developing handwriting recognition and replication software using Mathematica, Java, and MySQL
  - Implemented and tested image parsing and pattern matching algorithms to recognize individual letters in handwritten text
  - Implemented and tested curve fitting, curve smoothing, object thinning, and other image processing algorithms to replicate handwriting
  - Developed and executed software testing plans

positions.title: Scientific Analyst
positions.description:
- Developed and tested statistical models, including linear regressive, multivariate adaptive regressive splines (MARS), principal component, and data clustering models for large data sets
  - Developed and tested code for several web and database applications in PHP, MySQL, Perl, and Mathematica
  - Designed databases in MySQL and MS SQL, imported client data into these databases, and checked data for accuracy and completeness

positions.title: Ph. D. Graduate Student
positions.description:
- Performed molecular dynamics simulations of proteins to study high temperature unfolding pathways
  - Analyzed data from protein simulations using regression, clustering analysis, and other techniques
  - Developed a parallel implementation of the replica exchange sampling method, and applied it to the problem of protein folding

company.name: Daggett Biomolecular Dynamics Research Group, University of Washington

positions.title: Scientific Programmer
positions.description: - Wrote and tested Fortran code for implementing mooring and positional control modules in seakeeping simulation software

positions.title: M. Sc. Graduate Student
positions.description: - Tested the performance of six algorithms for calculating the transmission coefficient of an ion passing through an ion channel

company.name: Guelph Ion Channel Group, University of Guelph
